t:
No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.
This Act may be cited as the “Public Works and Atomic Energy Commission Appropriation Act, 1968”.

fable.w: This section only limits the availability of appropriations to the current fiscal year and gives the Act's short title. The tempting reading is that the word "Commission" in the short title signals an advisory body, but the Atomic Energy Commission is a federal agency and appears only as a proper noun. No party outside the federal government is consulted, heard, or given a right to sue over any federal decision.
fable.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard appropriations clause limiting the availability of funds to the current fiscal year. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. The mention of the 'Atomic Energy Commission' is merely part of the title of the Act and does not imply public participation in the decision-making process described in this specific text.
qwen_block.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.

opus.w: This section only limits how long appropriated funds remain available and gives the Act's short title. "Atomic Energy Commission" is the proper name of a federal agency, not an advisory body with outside members. No comment period, hearing, consultation, or right to sue is created.
opus.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard appropriations clause limiting the availability of funds to the current fiscal year. It does not establish any process for consulting with, coordinating with, or receiving input from parties outside the federal government. The mention of a 'Commission' in the act's title is irrelevant to the substantive content of this specific provision, which deals solely with budgetary constraints.
qwen_chat.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that the title "Public Works and Atomic Energy Commission Appropriation Act" implies the existence of a commission that involves public participation. However, the title of an act does not dictate the procedural requirements of the specific section, and the section itself contains no procedural mandates for consultation or coordination with outside parties.
